title: Shillong Ropeway Protest Enters Day 14 as Conrad Sangma Offers Dialogue

ai.summary: Women's groups in Meghalaya have joined an indefinite sit-in protest against the Shillong Peak ropeway project for 14 days, demanding its scrapping or relocation.

facts.claim: indefinite sit-in protest entered its 14th day
facts.quote: an indefinite sit-in protest entered its 14th day on Thursday

facts.claim: protest led by Joint Action Committee Against the Shillong Ropeway Project
facts.quote: The Joint Action Committee Against the Shillong Ropeway Project has been leading an indefinite sit-in against the proposed development.

facts.claim: women's organisations from Ri-Bhoi, West Khasi Hills and Eastern West Khasi Hills joined
facts.quote: The protest has drawn support from women's organisations across Ri-Bhoi, West Khasi Hills and Eastern West Khasi Hills.

facts.claim: women from Jaiaw, Mawlai and other localities in Shillong have also joined
facts.quote: Women from Jaiaw, Mawlai and other localities in Shillong have also joined the demonstration.

ai.background_note: The Shillong ropeway project faces opposition from women's groups in Meghalaya, with the protest now in its 14th day as the government offers dialogue.
ai.importance_reason: 2 outlets in the last 48 hours; coverage up from 2 to 3 reports this week.
